“`

Theoretically, the physical and spiritual existence of a Level Eleven life should have no limitations on lifespan.

However, in reality, the longer one lives, even if there are no problems with the physical and soul aspects, mental and spiritual will can still become distorted.

Once the spiritual will becomes distorted and insane, true death is not far away.

At this moment, the importance of a strong spiritual will is manifested.

The stronger the spiritual will, the more it can counteract this distortion and insanity.

...

Currently, with Lin Yuan’s strength of spiritual will, he could easily live through an entire Cosmic Era.

Even if it were not for the destruction of the universe and the collapse and depletion of the river of time

which ensures the death of all lives within the river, Lin Yuan would be able to live through multiple Cosmic Eras.

Additionally, a strong spiritual will has profound impacts on many aspects.

Especially in terms of soul defense, a strong spiritual will in place is more helpful than any soul-defensive artifact.

…

“Supreme Being, I have come this time to prepare for my breakthrough to Level Eleven.”

Lin Yuan mentioned the main issue, which was also one of the reasons he came to meet Xia Qin Supreme Being.

“Breakthrough to Level Eleven?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being immediately grasped the situation.

He had long guessed that Lin Yuan was here for this purpose.

However, just at the beginning of their meeting, he was so shocked by Lin Yuan’s terrifying spiritual will that he has not yet recovered.

“When are you planning to make the breakthrough?” Xia Qin Supreme Being asked seriously.

“In a few months,” Lin Yuan answered.

For a breakthrough, one must choose the best state of condition.

With Lin Yuan’s current rate of adjustment, a few months should suffice.

“No problem,” Xia Qin Supreme Being nodded.

“At that time, I will call them to be your protectors.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s expression turned slightly solemn.

‘Them’ naturally refers to the other nine Supreme Beings of human civilization.

Two to three hundred years ago, when Lin Yuan broke through to Level Ten, the disturbance was far beyond what Xia Qin Supreme Being had anticipated.

If it were not for forcibly borrowing the power of the Supreme Beings and the assist from the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being next door, it might have alerted other alien Supreme Beings with just Xia Qin Supreme Being’s own avatar’s power alone.

But this time, Xia Qin has learned his lesson and directly called in the other eight Supreme Beings of human civilization.

With the power of nine Supreme Beings, even protecting during the ultimate impact for Level Eleven will be more than sufficient.

Thus, Xia Qin Supreme Being believes that he is well-prepared this time.

“Rest assured, my true form will continuously watch over the Milky Way Main Star. You can proceed with your breakthrough without worries.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being added another sentence.

The true forms of the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization are all stationed at crucial nodes of the territory, deterring other alien Supreme Beings.

After all, the true form of a Supreme Being represents the highest battle power in the universe.

But for Lin Yuan’s breakthrough this time, Xia Qin Supreme Being is ready to mobilize his true form at any moment.

Ensuring that Lin Yuan successfully steps into Level Eleven is currently the most crucial task for human civilization, and it’s acceptable even to pay some price for it.

Besides, even if Xia Qin Supreme Being deploys his true form, it’s highly unlikely that the alien races will make any excessive moves unless they wish to provoke a full-scale war. Otherwise, a certain balance is generally maintained.

“Thank you, Supreme Being,” Lin Yuan said.

This is the advantage of having the support of a powerful force, being smooth sailing before fully growing up unless one intentionally seeks challenges to train themselves.

Otherwise, with Lin Yuan’s natural talent, he wouldn’t have to divert any attention to anything other than his breakthrough.

“No need to thank me,” Xia Qin Supreme Being shook his head slightly.

If other peak races in the universe knew that a monstrous talent like Lin Yuan was born within human civilization, they would probably go mad with envy.

“With your current strength, you should consider aiming for the ultimate.”

“The ultimate leap of a Level Eleven life, external forces might help but they certainly won’t play a dominant role,” Xia Qin Supreme Being rarely reminded.

Human civilization indeed possesses artifacts and methods to assist in the ultimate breakthrough, like that ‘Source of the Universe’.

But to step into Level Twelve and become a Supreme Being, it largely depends on oneself.

Lin Yuan nodded, “Understood.”

Currently, the most crucial artifact that Lin Yuan possesses for the ultimate impact is the ‘Heart of Space-Time’.

This is prepared by the Demonic Jade Tower Master for his own Direct Disciple, allowing one to escape the bindings of the river of time during the ultimate leap phase.

Compared to the ‘Source of the Universe,’ the ‘Heart of Space-Time’ has much greater effects.

“Good that you understand,” Xia Qin Supreme Being nodded.

Actually, these words are usually meant for Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers.

For Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers, stepping into the ultimate is just one step away, and receiving such reminders is more than normal.

As for a Level Tenn like Lin Yuan?

He is completely an exception.

…

“Supreme Being, there’s one more thing…”

Lin Yuan spoke lowly after discussing a few more things with Xia Qin Supreme Being.

“Go ahead,” Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan with a smile.

“I want to comprehend that segment of the Level Twelve physical body itself.”

Lin Yuan stated.

Within the Virtual World, that segment of the body is ultimately just a projection.

To thoroughly understand all demonic evolutionary paths, one must directly comprehend the physical body itself.

If this were before the tenth traversal, Lin Yuan definitely would not have easily done this; facing the remnant body of a creature of Level Twelve is highly risky for any being below Level Twelve.

“That segment of the body, well…”

“You… you should be fine.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being was just about to comment on whether Lin Yuan could withstand the psychic pressure from the body itself

but then immediately thought of Lin Yuan’s Supreme-level spiritual will; the psychic pressure from the remnant body at the same Supreme level poses no threat to another Supreme Being.
